usage: deskops desk [-h] {install,migrate,replace,update} ...

positional arguments:
  {install,migrate,replace,update}
    install             Scaffold a minimal local desk/ surface in a repo.
    migrate             Adopt a legacy or partial desk into the current non-
                        destructive workspace contract.
    replace             Replace an exact substring in one desk file that has
                        no modeled edit verb.
    update              Report and repair divergence between the current desk,
                        its models, and its store.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
